name: Marine Stewardship Council
body: Every image analyzed has alt text, every page a meta description, cookies are Secure, and an llms.txt is published. But Google Tag Manager loads and no consent tool or Consent Mode default appears in the HTML.
lesson: Add a consent tool, set Consent Mode defaults to denied, and fire tags only after a visitor agrees.
summary: www.msc.org scores 86 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 14 are at risk, and 22 pass. Fix first: 70 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 70 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /media-centre, /for-business/certification-bodies, /for-teachers/teach-learn-about-ocean-sustainability and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 4 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: The content security policy has gaps
fix.evidence: script-src allows 'unsafe-inline', script-src allows 'unsafe-eval', script-src allows any host.
fix.fix: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with nonces or hashes, limit hosts, and add object-src 'none' and base-uri 'self'.

fix.title: 17 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors
Every page has a meta description
